ja476:1.1: āha. Idh' eva haṃsa nipata, piyaṃ me tava dassanaṃ, issaro si anuppatto: yaṃ idh' atthi pavedayā 'ti.
ja476:2.1: Savanena c' ekassa piyā bhavanti, disvā pan' ekassa viheti chando, disvā ca sutvā ca piyā bhavanti, kaccin nu me piyyasi dassanena.
ja476:3.1: Savanena piyo me si bhiyyo cāgamma dassanaṃ, evaṃ piyadassano samāno vasa haṃsa mama santike ti.
ja476:4.1: Vaseyyāma tavāgāre niccaṃ sakkatapūjitā, matto va ekadā vajjā ‘haṃsarājaṃ pacantu me'.
ja476:5.1: Dhi-r-atthu taṃ annapānaṃ yaṃ me piyataraṃ tayā, na cāpi majjaṃ pāyāmi yāva me vacchasī ghare ti
ja476:6.1: Suvijānaṃ sigālānaṃ sakuntānañ ca vassitaṃ, manussavassitaṃ rāja dubbijānataraṃ tato.
ja476:7.1: Api ce maññatī poso ‘ñātimitto' ‘sakhā' ti vā yo pubbe sumano hutvā pacchā sampajjate diso.
ja476:8.1: Yasmiṃ mano nivisati avidūre sahāpi so, santike hi pi so dūre yasmā vivasate mano.
ja476:9.1: Anto pi yo hoti pasannacitto pāraṃ samuddassa pasannacitto, anto pi yo hoti paduṭṭhacitto pāraṃ samuddassa paduṭṭhacitto.
ja476:10.1: Saṃvasanto vivasanti ye disā te rathesabha, ārā santo saṃvasanti manasā raṭṭhavaḍḍhana.
ja476:11.1: Aticiraṃnivāsena piyo bhavati appiyo, āmanta kho taṃ gacchāma pura te homa appiyā ti.
ja476:12.1: Evaṃ ce yācamānānaṃ añjaliṃ nāvabujjhasi paricārakānaṃ sattānaṃ vacanaṃ na karosi no evaṃ taṃ abhiyācāma: puna kayirāsi pariyāyan ti.
ja476:13.1: Evaṃ ce no viharataṃ antarāyo na hessati tuyhaṃ vāpi mahārāja mayhaṃ vā raṭṭhavaddhana app-eva nāma passema ahorattānaṃ accaye ti.
